newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Universal App hits high on warrant expiry.
newsitem.headline: Universal App hits high on warrant expiry.

text.p: Universal Appliances Ltd rose to a year high on Friday, bid up by warrant-related buying ahead of the expiry of a one-for-one warrant, brokers said.

"Market makers are trying to boost the shares price to make it more attractive for warrant holders to exercise their rights ahead of the expiry of the warrant," a sales manager at a local brokerage said.
Universal Appliances shares rose HK$0.051, or 21.33 percent, to a 52-week high of HK$0.29 before steadying at HK$0.26 in late morning trade on a volume of 4.10 million shares.
